testResults.name: ui-production-build
testResults.result: BacktestView canvas component builds and renders: PnL/equity curve with entry/exit trade markers, per-instrument price panels above and below, single locked time axis with synchronized pan/zoom and independent value axes, fixture-driven demo route without a backend

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide gates passed after the UI scaffold landed

limitations: The read-only Thesis backend endpoint serving equity/fills/price series from imported artifacts is a backend follow-up; the demo renders from fixtures
